description.value: Kitchen Kodama is a Japanese food truck on Rainbow Road on Salt Spring Island, specializing in okonomiyaki — a traditional savory-and-sweet Japanese pancake known as the 'as you like it' dish. The truck is featured as a local food destination in the Lockwood Farms partner network spanning the Cowichan Valley region. Cyclists riding Salt Spring Island's rural roads will find it a distinctive stop for a hot, made-to-order Japanese street food meal.
